_comment: Text corrections applied to extracted VPK strings before writing content/game records. Each entry is a regex 'find' applied via re.sub against every string field (description, lore, notes, names). The 'where' field is optional: if present, the correction only applies to matching extracted entity types such as items_full, units_full, synergies, relics, or abilities. The 'note' field is human-readable context, ignored at runtime.

corrections.note: Blink Dagger and Overwhelming Blink misspell 'furthest' as 'farest'.
